title: Decent idea, poorly executed
text:
Thought this would be fun, but returned more albums than I kept. This would be fine, but you don’t really have the opportunity to skip the month because you aren’t notified. You might be able to skip if you happen to check your orders at the right time, before it ships. If it’s already getting ready to be shipped you can’t cancel and you aren’t refunded the full amount. The subscription price is more than any records received. It’s not an average price where you may receive some over the cost of subscription and some under that cost.

Takeaway: it’s less fun or a surprise, but buy your own records or try a different subscription. This is poorly done.
label: negative
